# CashKaro

> > India's leading cashback and coupon platform offering rewards on 1500+ retailers, 10,000+ brands, and 1 million+ products.

CashKaro is a comprehensive cashback rewards platform that aggregates deals, promo codes, and discounts from major Indian e-commerce retailers like Amazon, Flipkart, and Myntra. Users can earn cashback on purchases across electronics, fashion, groceries, and other categories while accessing exclusive coupon codes and price comparisons.

## Key Topics

- Cashback rewards
- Promo codes & coupons
- Online shopping
- Price comparison
- Product deals
- Discount codes
- Amazon
- Flipkart
- Myntra
- Electronics
- Fashion
- Mobile phones
- Laptops
- India shopping
- Referral program

## Core Platforms & Retailers

- [CashKaro Homepage](https://cashkaro.com): CashKaro homepage: cashback rewards, coupons & promo codes for Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra
- [Store Directory](https://cashkaro.com/stores): Store directory: 1500+ retailers including Amazon, Myntra, Flipkart
- [Amazon Promo Codes & Cashback](https://cashkaro.com/stores/amazon): Amazon promo codes: up to 80% off + 3.5% cashback rewards
- [Flipkart Coupon Codes & Cashback](https://cashkaro.com/stores/flipkart): Flipkart coupons: up to 80% off + 7% cashback via CashKaro
- [Myntra Coupons & Offers](https://cashkaro.com/stores/myntra): Myntra coupons: fashion deals up to 80% off + 6% cashback rewards
